name: European Union (EMA, centralised procedure)

changes.notes: Annex II and small immediate packaging templates; generic SmPC compared with its reference (Article 11 omissions); four new rule cards (EU-A2, EU-SMALL, EU-GEN-SAME, EU-GEN-CARVE); vial label and generic samples with drills; 28 more quiz questions. Source links checked on 2026-10-17: moved pages updated and secondary sources replaced with official ones where they exist.
First release (Phase 3): QRD v10.4 SmPC, package leaflet, outer carton and blister; excipients, black triangle, Braille, safety features, user testing, translations, PRAC and PSUSA, ePI view.

about: Product information for a centrally authorised medicine: the Summary of Product Characteristics (Annex I), the labelling (Annex IIIA: outer carton and blister) and the package leaflet (Annex IIIB), following QRD template version 10.4. National procedures use the same headings with national details. Where a check estimates or simplifies, its rule card says so.

watch.title: QRD template version 11
watch.text: EMA consulted on QRD v11 (April to August 2025): a shorter leaflet, important information first, warnings grouped by subject and an optional section 7 for instructions for use. Until v11 is published and in force, the app checks against v10.4 and teaches v11 in a lesson.

watch.title: Key information section in the leaflet
watch.text: EMA also consulted (April to May 2025) on a key information section at the top of the package leaflet of centrally authorised medicines. No decision has been published; the app does not require it.

watch.title: Electronic product information (ePI)
watch.text: The EU ePI common standard is based on HL7 FHIR. EMA published guidance for submitting ePI in centralised procedures in September 2026, ahead of go-live, and the new EU pharmaceutical legislation (political agreement December 2025) requires ePI. The app shows a simplified structured ePI view; it does not produce FHIR.
